paite: Huan Joshua zingkhang in athou a, Israel suan tengteng toh Shittim a pan akisuan ua, Jordan lui atung uhi. Agalkah ma un huai ah agiak uhi.
heading: Israel Mipite'n Jordan Akan Uh
english: Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel. They camped there before they crossed over.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni thum nung in heutute'n giahphual ava tawn vialvial uhi.
english: After three days, the officers went through the middle of the camp;

paite: "TOUPA na Pathian uh thukhun bawm leh siampute, Levi chite'n azawn uh na muh chiang un na omna ua kipan kisuan unla, na zui ding uh ahi.
english: and they commanded the people, saying, “When you see the ark of Yahweh your God’s covenant, and the Levitical priests bearing it, then leave your place and follow it.

paite: Himahleh nou toh akal tehna tong sangnih vel ahi ding ahi. Naih kei unla, huchi in na paina ding lampi na theithei ding uhi. Hiai lampi lah tuma lam in na tawn ngei ngal kei ua," chi in mipite thu apia uhi.
english: Yet there shall be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits by measure—don’t come closer to it—that you may know the way by which you must go; for you have not passed this way before.”

paite: Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "Kihihsiangthou un, zingchiang a TOUPA'N na lak ua thillamdang mahmah hih ding ahi," achi hi.
english: Joshua said to the people, “Sanctify yourselves; for tomorrow Yahweh will do wonders among you.”

paite: Joshua in siampute kiang ah, "Thukhun bawm zawng unla, mipite ma ah galkah un," achi hi. Huchi in thukhun bawm azawng ua, mipite ma ah apaita uhi.
english: Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and cross over before the people.” They took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, “Mosi kiang a ka om bang in na kiang ah ka om ding, chih atheihtheihna ding un, tuni in Israel tengteng mitmuh in ka hon pahtawi pan ding hi.
heading: Joshua Kiang A TOUPA Thu
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.

paite: Thukhun bawm zawng siampute, Jordan lui gei na tun chiang un, Jordan lui ah dingden un, chi in thu pia in,” achi hi.
english: You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘When you come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.’”

paite: Joshua in Israel suante kiang ah, "Hong pai unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh thu hong ngaikhia un," achi hi.
heading: Mipite Kiang A Joshua Thu
english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “Come here, and hear the words of Yahweh your God.”

paite: Joshua in, "Hiai ah Pathian hing na lak uah a-om a, na ma uah Kanaante, Hitte, Hivte, Perizte, Girgaste, Amorte leh Jebuste adelhkhe ngeingei ding hi.
english: Joshua said, “By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Jebusite out from before you.

paite: Ngai un, leitung pumpi TOUPA thukhun bawm in na ma uah Jordan lui akan hi.
english: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passes over before you into the Jordan.

paite: Israel namte lak a mi sawm-le-nih, nam chih sik in mi khat zel telkhia un.
english: Now therefore take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA leitung pumpi TOUPA bawm zawng siampute khepek Jordan tui a akingaktak in, saklam a pan Jordan tui hong luangte akitat dia; ahong kiching venvon ding," achi hi.
english: It shall be that when the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of Yahweh, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan will be cut off. The waters that come down from above shall stand in one heap.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipite Jordan lui kan dia apuanin ua kipan apawt lai un, mipite ma ah thukhun bawm zawng siampute apai uhi.
heading: Jordan Lui Kanna
english: When the people moved from their tents to pass over the Jordan, the priests who bore the ark of the covenant being before the people,

paite: Bawm zawngte Jordan lui ava tung ua, bawm zawng siampute khe in tui gei asiktak in, buhlak sung teng Jordan lui a kuang tengteng ah tui alet gige hi.
english: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),

paite: Saklam a pan tuipi luang lai akhawlta a, gamla kuamtak a Zarethan gam chin a Adam ah ahong kiching hi. Arabah tuipi, Chi Tuipi lam a luangsuk lai akitat geih a; huchi in Jeriko khozawntak ah mipite agalkahta uhi.
english: the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan; and those that went down toward the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, were wholly cut off. Then the people passed over near Jericho.

paite: Jordan lui lai ah TOUPA thukhun bawm zawng siampute leihul ah adingh ua, mipi tengteng Jordan lui agalkah vek uhi.
english: The priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.
